currentHeading: ### To Meet Each at Their Depth
authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Canon and claim content remain author decisions.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0005 records a conflict about subsistence conditionality across the corpus, and CTD-0088 requires that shelter never depend on participation. The shipped sentence forbidding conditional shelter is kept, which is the strongest form of the CTD-0005 position available in this volume.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. Material shelter must never depend on spiritual participation, mentor approval, or progress through the curriculum is absent from the baseline and is retained.

findings.summary: The three stages of the offering were cut.

evidence.baseline: refuge first, for those who arrive in need of it; then practice; then, in time, the invitation to extend to others the sanctuary they were given
evidence.shipped: offered refuge or practice without diagnosis, and free to refuse either

findings.diagnosis: The three stages are the principle. The invitation to extend to others the sanctuary they were given is how a community reproduces rather than merely serves, and it is the only place the volume describes a person moving from receiving to giving. The no diagnosis correction is right and is kept.

findings.summary: The image of the community arranged so that both can stand in one room was deleted.

evidence.baseline: The community is arranged so that a newcomer in need of shelter and a practitioner ready to teach can stand in the same room, each receiving what is theirs to receive.

findings.diagnosis: This is the section’s only concrete picture and its landing. It is also the answer to the obvious objection that pacing depth means sorting people into tiers.

debtImpact.note: The unconditional shelter sentence and the no diagnosis requirement are both kept.
This volume states the unconditional position. The corpus conflict recorded in the item is not resolved here.
